title: Dependency velocity matrix and mitigation playbook
creator: Leah Kim
description:
Problem: Cross-functional roadmap dependencies often stall releases because teams surface different signals (capacity, design readiness, security gating) too late. We need a concise operational artifact that lets PMs and partners triage dependency velocity, prioritize mitigations, and automate escalation triggers.

Goal: Create a Dependency Velocity Matrix (DVM) + Mitigation Playbook that is lightweight (single-page matrix + playbook) and integrates into the Console and Linear workflows. The DVM will score dependencies by expected lead time, variability, and criticality, and the playbook will prescribe rapid mitigations and owners for each score band.
background:
We already track dependencies in several passive artifacts (dependency registry, readiness signalboard). However, those artifacts lack a short-form operational view for sprint-to-sprint decision making. Recent incidents (latency regression rollout blocked due to KV cache kernel mismatch) exposed long handoffs between runtime, infra, and security that could have been mitigated with earlier triage. PMs want a pragmatic tool: predict likely blockers, recommend mitigations, and provide deterministic escalation.

This ticket synthesizes learnings from the Roadmap Dependency Sprint in Q4 2025, the Console rollouts in runtime-1.18, and the Dedicated autoscaling beta handoff notes.
proposed_solution:
1) Define DVM schema: fields = dependency_id, impacted_release, owning_team, expected_lead_days, variance_days, criticality (low/med/high), mitigation_tier (A/B/C), current_action, last_updated.
2) Implement a Google Sheet + Console widget prototype to surface top 20 active dependencies by weighted risk (expected_lead_days * criticality_weight).
3) Draft Mitigation Playbook: For each mitigation_tier provide step-by-step actions (e.g., Tier A: schedule 30-min unblock with owning eng + design, apply TEMP feature-flag fallback; Tier B: create canary with reduced traffic and assign SRE on-call; Tier C: monitor and defer).
4) Add Linear automation templates to spawn follow-up tasks with prefilled fields (owner, suggested due_date, checklist).
5) Run a 2-week pilot with 3 squads (Serving Runtime, Console, Dedicated) and iterate on scoring weights.
6) Hand off to PM operations and embed in quarterly PR review cadence.
acceptance_criteria: DVM schema documented and stored in Confluence with examples
Console prototype widget shows top 20 dependencies and is demoable to leadership
Mitigation Playbook created with at least 6 concrete mitigations mapped to Tier A/B/C
Linear automation templates created and validated in staging
Pilot run completed and artifact updated with pilot learnings
Ownership: each active dependency in pilot has an assigned owner and initial action
rollout_plan: Week 0: Finalize schema and mitigation tiers; collect initial dependency samples from squads
Week 1: Build Sheet prototype and Linear templates; design Console widget mock
Week 2: Implement Console widget MVP and link to Google Sheet; QA with one SRE and one PM
Week 3-4: Pilot with 3 squads; weekly triage meetings to validate scoring and actions
Week 5: Synthesize pilot feedback; finalize playbook and templates
Week 6: Hand-off to PM Operations and schedule inclusion in PR playbook for next quarterly planning
metrics: Mean time from dependency detection to assigned owner (target: <= 48h)
% of critical (high) dependencies with mitigation plan before freeze (target: 90%)
Number of unplanned rollbacks attributable to cross-team dependency misses (target: reduce by 50% next quarter)
Pilot satisfaction score from participating PMs and ENG leads (target: >= 4/5)
risks_mitigations: Risk: Teams may not keep the DVM updated -> Mitigation: Linear automation to remind owners and surface stale items in Console
Risk: Scoring weights may mis-prioritize technical nuance -> Mitigation: include ‘technical complexity note’ field and require ENG sign-off for high variance items
Risk: Console widget scope creep -> Mitigation: v1 intentionally read-only with links to canonical artifacts; full write-back deferred to phase 2
Risk: Security gating unknowns late in cycle -> Mitigation: add SEC reviewer to weekly triage and template checklist with minimum security artifacts
